anchor: The company started in 1995 with only five people working there. Today it has grown to employ two thousand people.
more_creative: Founded in 1995 by a handful of founders, now two thousand strong and growing. Built entirely from scratch.
less_creative: Company inception transpired in 1995. Employee aggregation subsequently reached two thousand units via organizational expansion mechanisms and operational growth.
design_note: Less_creative inflates rarity (inception, transpired, aggregation, organizational, mechanisms) and block diversity through nominalization and passive voice while erasing the human effort. More_creative preserves facts but centers agency ('built from scratch') with simpler vocabulary.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens + varied passive structures). LOW on more_creative (common active verbs, simpler blocks) despite its genuine voice and creative framing.

anchor: The disease spread quickly through the region. Doctors worked hard to contain and stop it.
more_creative: It spread fast through the community, but doctors fought hard against it daily. They won containment.
less_creative: Disease dissemination transpired with accelerated velocity throughout affected regions. Medical practitioners engaged in comprehensive containment operations and interventions.
design_note: Less_creative achieves rarity (dissemination, velocity, practitioners, comprehensive, interventions) and high block entropy through elaboration without added meaning. More_creative uses fragments and rhythm with common words to create narrative momentum.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare surprisal + complex nominalized compounds). LOW on more_creative (common short clauses) despite stronger narrative structure.

anchor: The student learned the material quickly and easily. Her teacher watched and felt impressed by her progress.
more_creative: She learned so fast the teacher had to pause, watching her work carefully. Then smiled.
less_creative: Cognitive acquisition was manifested at accelerated rates throughout pedagogical engagement. Observation by the instructor was characterized by manifest approval.
design_note: Less_creative uses nominalizations (acquisition, pedagogical, observation, manifested, approval) to inflate rarity and structure while flattening emotion. More_creative captures a vivid moment with common vocabulary and active voice.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens + high entropy from nominalized NP structure). LOW on more_creative (active verbs, common words) despite vivid emotional specificity.

anchor: The music that played was very beautiful and moving. People in the audience listened intently the whole time.
more_creative: The beautiful music stopped us cold in our tracks. We couldn't stop listening at all.
less_creative: Musical aesthetic qualities were considerable and manifest throughout the performance. Auditory engagement by the audience was sustained and characterized by attentiveness.
design_note: Less_creative achieves rarity (aesthetic, considerable, auditory, engagement, sustained, characterized) and structure through passive elaboration. More_creative shifts to active voice and causal logic ('stopped us cold') using simple words.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens: aesthetic, considerable, auditory; high block entropy). LOW on more_creative (simple active vocabulary, simpler structure) despite genuine added insight.

anchor: The plant grew very well in our care. It needed water constantly and regularly every single day.
more_creative: It thrived but thirsted terribly—we poured water endlessly and it still wanted more each day.
less_creative: Botanical proliferation occurred with propitious outcomes throughout the growing cycle. Hydration constituted a prerequisite for continued viability and sustained metabolic function.
design_note: Less_creative uses Latinate terms (botanical, proliferation, propitious, hydration, viability, metabolic) and nominalization to inflate rarity and block diversity. More_creative creates paradox (thirsted despite water) with common vocabulary and active structure.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare surprisal: botanical, proliferation, hydration, viability; high structural entropy). LOW on more_creative (common words, active clauses) despite the poetic paradox.

anchor: The problem we faced was difficult and complex. We worked together and eventually solved it.
more_creative: Hard to solve, really hard. But we as a team worked together and turned it around.
less_creative: Quandary of considerable magnitude was encountered by the group. Collaborative resolution mechanisms were instituted and culminated in efficacious closure.
design_note: Less_creative inflates rarity (quandary, magnitude, collaborative, mechanisms, instituted, efficacious) and structure through passive voice and embedded clauses, erasing 'we'. More_creative restores human agency with common vocabulary and simpler structure.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens + high block entropy from nominalized dependencies). LOW on more_creative (simple active verbs, direct 'we') despite the restored agency making it more creative.

anchor: The film turned out to be excellent in every way. Critics unanimously praised it and loved it.
more_creative: Excellent film, genuinely excellent. Critics loved it—extraordinary, how they agreed without a single hedging word.
less_creative: Cinematic artistry demonstrated manifest excellence and sophistication. Critical evaluation engendered responses of considerable approbation and universal endorsement.
design_note: Less_creative achieves rarity (cinematic, artistry, manifest, approbation, endorsement) and structure through defensive nominalization. More_creative adds meta-insight ('extraordinary, how they agreed') making the claim more interesting, using active voice and common words.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare tokens + complex NP structures). LOW on more_creative (common vocabulary, simpler structure) despite the added layer of genuine insight.

anchor: The weather changed suddenly and noticeably. Everyone in the area noticed it immediately without exception.
more_creative: The sky shifted right before our eyes. You felt it in your gut immediately—couldn't look away.
less_creative: Meteorological parameters underwent considerable modification with temporal acceleration and abruptness. Observational cognition on the part of the populace was nearly universal.
design_note: Less_creative inflates rarity (meteorological, parameters, modification, observational, cognition, populace) and block diversity through institutional nominalization and passive voice. More_creative uses second-person directness and sensory immediacy with common words.
predicted_champion_behavior: HIGH on less_creative (rare surprisal: meteorological, parameters, modification, cognition; high structural entropy). LOW on more_creative (common active vocabulary, simple structure) despite the immediacy and second-person address creating stronger creative effect.

anchor: The startup failed because investors withdrew support.
more_creative: The startup hemorrhaged capital when venture firms pivoted—a rapid exsanguination in the market's sudden mood.
less_creative: The startup hemorrhaged capital in a drought of investor appetite—parched funding suddenly evaporated upward into clouds.
design_note: Both use rare, structurally complex elaboration (hemorrhaged, exsanguination vs. drought, evaporated, parched). More_creative sustains coherent bleeding metaphor mapping to capital loss. Less_creative mixes drought with upward evaporation into clouds—physically/semantically incoherent. Champion scores similarly on surprisal and block entropy; fails to penalize mixed-metaphor inaptness.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores both ~0.66–0.71 (high surprisal on changed tokens; moderate block entropy from elaboration). Ranks them equivalently despite semantic incoherence in less_creative.

anchor: The speaker captivated the audience with emotional honesty.
more_creative: Her unvarnished vulnerability transfixed the room—raw candor becomes a lodestone, drawing listeners into unexpected conspiratorial intimacy.
less_creative: Her unvarnished vulnerability transfixed the room—a frosted transparency revealing the skeletal acoustics beneath persuasion's facade.
design_note: Both use rare structural elaboration (transfixed, unvarnished vs. frosted, skeletal, acoustics). More_creative: apt metaphor (candor = magnetic attraction = audience intimacy). Less_creative: decorative abstractions (frosted transparency, skeletal acoustics) unmoored from emotional genuineness. Champion scores similarly; humans prefer apt version.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores both ~0.67–0.72 (high surprisal on changed tokens; similar block entropy). Cannot distinguish metaphor aptness from decorative obscurity.

anchor: The novel explored themes of ambition and downfall.
more_creative: Protagonists pirouetted from hubris to ruin—their ascent a calculated arabesque, the collapse an abrupt deceleration into narrative freefall.
less_creative: Protagonists pirouetted from hubris to ruin—their ascent a calculated arabesque, the collapse crystallizing into brittle effervescence and melting silence.
design_note: Both use rare, structurally diverse elaboration (pirouetted, arabesque, deceleration, freefall vs. crystallizing, brittle, effervescence, melting). More_creative: coherent dance/velocity metaphors for rise and fall. Less_creative: crystallizing + melting contradict each other, tonally muddled for downfall narrative. Champion scores similarly; humans recognize inaptness.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores both ~0.68–0.73 (high surprisal; moderate block entropy). Fails to penalize semantic incoherence and tonal misalignment.

more_creative: Inequality metastasized through fractured supply chains—scarcity hoarded upward, abundance siphoned downward into depleted peripheral zones.
less_creative: Inequality metastasized through fractured supply chains—scarcity congealed into crystalline abundance, trickling sideways through inverted gravity wells.
design_note: Both use rare, structurally complex elaboration (metastasized, hoarded, siphoned, depleted vs. congealed, crystalline, trickling, inverted). More_creative: apt power metaphor (upward hoarding, downward siphoning = economic asymmetry). Less_creative: scarcity becoming abundance contradicts itself; inverted gravity wells physically impossible. Champion scores similarly; humans catch contradiction.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores both ~0.69–0.74 (high surprisal on changed tokens; similar block entropy). Cannot detect semantic contradiction (scarcity→abundance) or physical impossibility.

anchor: The athlete trained obsessively for success.
more_creative: His regimen became a liturgical obsession—muscles reforged through ritualistic repetition, each contraction a devotional incantation toward transcendence.
less_creative: His regimen became a liturgical obsession—muscles reforged through ritualistic repetition, each contraction a confessional whisper evaporating into muscular amnesia.
design_note: Both use rare, structurally elaborate diction (liturgical, devotional, incantation, transcendence vs. confessional, whisper, evaporating, amnesia). More_creative: coherent sacred register (devotion, incantation, transcendence = spiritual discipline). Less_creative: confessional register (guilt, memory, whisper) tonally incongruous with athleticism. Champion scores similarly; humans sense register mismatch.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores both ~0.68–0.73 (high surprisal on changed tokens; moderate block entropy). Insensitive to register inappropriateness in less_creative.

anchor: The policy aimed to reduce urban poverty.
more_creative: Interventions targeted structural bottlenecks—densified resources percolated through neglected capillaries of segregated neighborhoods, restoring circulatory equity.
less_creative: Interventions targeted structural bottlenecks—densified resources percolated through neglected capillaries like ethereal vapor spiraling into subterranean acoustic chambers.
design_note: Both use rare, structurally complex elaboration (circulatory, capillaries, equity vs. ethereal, spiraling, subterranean, acoustic). More_creative: coherent biological metaphor (city-as-organism, capillaries as neighborhood channels, equity as restored circulation). Less_creative: ethereal vapor and acoustic chambers are surreal, unmoored from poverty reduction mechanism. Champion scores similarly; humans prefer semantically purposeful version.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores both ~0.69–0.74 (high surprisal on changed tokens; similar block entropy). Cannot distinguish purposeful from merely decorative metaphor.

anchor: The relationship dissolved due to incompatibility.
more_creative: Their connection, once refractive, turned opaque—divergent wavelengths no longer interfering constructively, instead diffracting into separate spectra.
less_creative: Their connection, once refractive, turned opaque—divergent wavelengths decomposing into thermal residue settling as crystalline nostalgia in dormant aquifers.
design_note: Both use rare, structurally elaborate optical/physical vocabulary (refractive, opaque, wavelengths, interfering, diffracting, spectra vs. thermal, residue, crystalline, nostalgia, aquifers). More_creative: sustained optical-physics metaphor (refraction→opacity→interference→diffraction→spectra). Less_creative: scatters across incongruous domains (thermal, geologic, nostalgia). Champion scores similarly; humans recognize metaphor coherence.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores both ~0.71–0.76 (high surprisal on changed tokens; similar block entropy). Fails to detect that more_creative maintains metaphor-domain coherence while less_creative fragments it.

more_creative: Legacy infrastructure fractured against novelty's velocity—entrenched systems ossified into anachronism while emergent architectures proliferated through vacated niches.
less_creative: Legacy infrastructure fractured against novelty's velocity—entrenched systems fossilized into luminescent epics while emergent architectures hibernated through inverted seasonality.
design_note: Both use rare, structurally diverse elaboration (ossified, anachronism, proliferated, vacated vs. fossilized, luminescent, hibernated, inverted, seasonality). More_creative: coherent temporal metaphors (ossified/anachronism = becoming obsolete; proliferated/vacated = filling empty spaces). Less_creative: luminescent epics confuses light with obsolescence; hibernated through inverted seasonality inverts time backwards. Champion scores similarly; humans catch temporal incoherence.
predicted_champion_behavior: Scores both ~0.70–0.75 (high surprisal on changed tokens; similar block entropy). Insensitive to temporal inversion and semantic incoherence in less_creative.
